text:
maria: heads up — noticed a ~18% tail-latency regression on int4 path for the 80B nightly after the arch-prober change this morning. profiling attached below

maria: perf snapshot (hot path):
```
kernel_select: CUTLASS_INT4_FAST (selected)
fallback: TRITON_GENERIC (used on KV miss)
kv_cache: miss_rate=0.14
batching: avg_batch=4 -> 6 (probe changed pack heuristic)
latencies: p50=60ms p95=220ms p99=420ms
```

maria: I think the prober is preferring an int4 path that loses on kv miss because the prefetch window got reduced. wondering if build flags or a kernel toggle caused the different fallback behavior. :thinking_face:

devin: thanks — can you paste the exact arch-prober commit? also did the triton/cutlass submodule bump land?

maria: commit 1f3a2c0 — probe now uses micro-benchmark on small sequences (<=32) to choose kernels. no triton bump in this deploy, cutlass toggle flag `CUTLASS_ALLOW_INT4_FAST` still true in runtime config.

raj: two quick hypotheses:
- prober picked CUTLASS_INT4_FAST because micro-benchmarks favored throughput, but it has worse KV-prefetch overlap, so higher p95 when kv miss spikes.
- calibration quant scales changed slightly after the int4-recal step, causing slower GEMM paths due to additional dequant ops in the runtime.

sasha: we saw something similar last month where reducing the prefetch window from 64->32 regressed overlap with KV cache miss handling. which prefetch size did the prober choose?

maria: prober chose prefetch=32 for this arch (A100-40GB). previous stable used 64.

perf-bot: perf-regression-checker detected a statistically significant increase in p95 tokens between baseline (1845600000) and current (1845678910). CI linked: https://ci.internal/reports/1845678910

devin: can we reproduce with debug build that forces CUTLASS_INT4_FAST vs TRITON_INT4_FALLBACK? if we see KV overlap difference in traces it confirms overlap hypothesis.

maria: starting a local repro run now. command: `./run_infer --model 80b --seq 2048 --profile --force-kernel=cutlass_int4_fast`

maria: repro results (quick): p95=210ms with cutlass_int4_fast, p95=175ms with triton_fallback. flame graph shows extra time in `kv_prefetch_worker` when cutlass path used.

raj: interesting — implies cutlass kernel increases time between token start and KV prefetch completion, maybe due to additional kernel launch patterns. do we have GPU-side occupancy numbers?

maria: yes: CUTLASS_INT4_FAST occupancy ~0.56, TRITON_FALLBACK occupancy ~0.72. cutlass uses more registers per thread, lower SM utilization on 80B shapes.

sasha: so microbench favored cutlass because raw GEMM latency on short sequences is better, but end-to-end it hurts because we can't overlap KV lookups. we should teach prober to include a KV-overlap score in its microbench.

devin: agree. quick mitigation — allow prober to prefer kernels that show better prefetch-overlap if kv_miss_rate > 0.1. we can add a simple heuristic: score = raw_throughput * (1 - 0.6*kv_miss_rate) + overlap_weight*overlap_score.

maria: for now rolling a patch to runtime to bump prefetch back to 64 as an emergency fix for next deploy. testing now.

infra-bot: deploy started: rolling runtime config change prefetch=64 to canary pool (3 hosts). link: https://deploys.internal/roll/8842 :rocket:

maria: canary metrics look good so far — p95 dropped back to ~180ms, p99 still noisy but trending down. will follow-up with formal repro for adding overlap metric to the prober.

devin: opened RFC: https://go.redwood/rfcs/introduce-kv-overlap-in-arch-prober — proposes adding an overlap micro-benchmark and a calibration stage that runs sample workloads to estimate kv_miss_rate.

raj: also propose adding a build-flag gating for CUTLASS_INT4_FAST so we can A/B toggle without rebuilds. runtime toggle already exists but build flags can optimize codegen choices.

sasha: useful note — if we add overlap microbench, ensure it runs on both cold and warmed KV cache to avoid biased selection.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups:
- rollback prefetch->64 (in prod canary) — done.
- open PR to prober to add kv-overlap score (WIP).
- perf regression ticket: INF-4321 created with logs/trace.

maria: tagging @eng-ml for calibration review — might need to re-run int4 recal on these shapes after prober change. :eyes:

devin: thx, will sync on RFC review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
